query:
INSERT INTO
  successions (released, successor)
SELECT DISTINCT
  flailed.job,
  ?1
FROM
  flailed
  JOIN releases ON releases.job = flailed.job
WHERE
  flailed.message = ?2
  AND flailed.ordinal = ?3
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      successions
    WHERE
      successions.released = flailed.job
  )
